desc: Parse S with a stack into nodes (virtual root + one node per '('), recording each node's children; process iteratively to avoid recursion depth issues.
Compute canonical subtree IDs bottom-up in reverse creation order: sort child IDs, map sorted tuple -> fresh integer ID via a dictionary.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N modulo 998244353.
For each node including the virtual root, multiply answer by factorial[degree] and by inverse-factorial[frequency] for each distinct child canonical ID.

Validate the counting formula and implementation against a brute-force reachability/orbit search (generate reachable strings via the block reversal operation, dedupe) on small valid sequences up to N=10; confirm the tree/plane-embedding characterization and fix any discrepancy.
